KANNON K. SHANMUGAM 
(202) 434-5050 
kshanmugam@wc.com 

BY MESSENGER AND ELECTRONIC FILING 

June 28, 2018 

Mr. Scott Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC  20543 

Re:  Republic of Sudan v. Harrison, et al., No. 16-1094 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent respondents in the above-captioned matter.  On behalf of both parties, 
I am writing to request extensions of time on the merits briefs and joint appendix in this 
case, as follows: 

Brief of petitioner (and joint appendix): 
Brief of respondents: 

August 15, 2018 
September 19, 2018 

Both  parties  have  agreed  to  the  foregoing  schedule,  which  would  enable  this  case  to  be 
heard  during  the  Court’s  November  2018  sitting.    Should  you  need  any  additional 
information from us, please do not hesitate to let me know. 

Yours sincerely, 

/s/ 

Kannon K. Shanmugam 

cc: 

Christopher M. Curran, Esq. (counsel for petitioner)
